content: this is a summary of a civil case that took place in vilnius city district court the defendant has been ordered to pay legal and court fees the court decided to award the defendant a portion of the property including a barn shed kitchen woodshed and backyard buildings upon the dissolution of the marriage the case discusses two articles from the civil code related to the establishment of an asset balance and the determination of asset value the applicant seeks the annulment and dissolution of the marriage division of matrimonial property and for the defendant to retain their married name the defendant claims to not be divorced yet and has applied for the recognition and enforcement of a judgment in lithuania the defendant was properly served with procedural documents and given a period to respond the defendant failed to appoint an authorized representative so the documents are considered served the court must determine how to divide the joint property of the spouses pay off any debts related to the community property and determine the value of the community property in this case the court awarded a portion of immovable properties to the defendant and ordered the defendant to pay the applicants costs the court also dissolved the marriage and awarded certain property to the defendant
